ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (Entwicklungsstand)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description: Version 0.21.1 audit hotfix: The Dev complete-all Gizmo now creates and finishes the final Mechanoid quest in quest history as well as unlocking Machine Silence. Seven-wave forge elite selection is aligned with seven waves; Mech defenders count already-existing enemy mechanoids toward the 100-enemy limit; new mech quest and power texts are localized in English and German. Version 0.21: The Silence of Iron is an additional automatically offered world-map Mechanoid battle after all 13 ghost trials. Winning unlocks Aragorn's Machine Silence: select within 30 cells, stun hostile mechanoids within radius 6 for 600 ticks (10 seconds at normal speed), 3600-tick cooldown (60 seconds at normal speed). King's five 20-damage armor-piercing Burn strikes can hit the same survivor repeatedly and cooldown is now 3750 ticks. Global 0.5x-5x danger slider (default 2x), settlement wealth/storyteller threat-budget scaling, role-specific quest factors (rescue 1x, crypts 1.25x, forge 1.75x, mechs 2.5x), and a limit of 100 active quest enemies. Dev complete-all unlocks the new quest power; Dev reset covers its cooldown. All v0.20 graphics, ghosts, rescue, forging and skills retained. In-game validation still recommended.
